title: Shopping
source:
Hello Mary! How are things going? I've found two photos for our school project "Ways of shopping", and I'd like to explain why I've chosen them.

Both pictures show people shopping for clothes, but in different ways. In the first photo, a teenage girl is browsing an online clothes shop while sitting at home, whereas the second picture shows two young women looking at a jacket in a shop. Unlike the girl in the first photo, who is shopping from home, the two friends are in a real shop. 

Shopping online has several advantages. You can compare prices and choose from a wide range of products without leaving home. What's more, online shops are open around the clock, so you can buy things whenever it's convenient for you. However, you can't try clothes on before buying them, which means they might not fit properly.

As for shopping in a physical shop, you can try things on and check their quality before making a purchase. Another benefit is that you can get advice from shop assistants if you need help. The main drawback is that visiting shops can be time-consuming, especially when they're crowded or far from home.

Personally, I prefer shopping in physical shops because I like trying clothes on and making sure they fit me well before buying them.

Call me when you have some free time. Bye!

pros.title: Pros & Cons
pros.html:
Online shopping

Advantages

  • You can easily compare prices.
  • Online shops often offer discounts.
  • Customer reviews help you choose.
  • You can shop without leaving home.

Disadvantages

  • Clothes may not fit properly.
  • Delivery can take several days.
  • Returning items can be difficult.
  • Products may look different online.

Shopping in a physical shop

Advantages

  • You can try clothes on before buying them.
  • You can check the quality yourself.
  • Shop assistants can offer advice.
  • You can take purchases home immediately.

Disadvantages

  • Shops can be crowded.
  • Popular sizes may be out of stock.
  • You may have to queue at the till.
  • Travelling to shops takes time.

title: Watching films
source:
Hello Sophie! How's it going? I've just found two photos for our school project "Watching films", and I think they illustrate two popular ways of enjoying films.

In the first picture, a family of four are watching a film together on the sofa at home, with their dog lying beside them, whereas the second photo shows a group of young people enjoying a film at the cinema. Unlike the family, who are relaxing in their living room, the people in the second picture are sitting in a large cinema auditorium with other filmgoers.

Watching films at home has several advantages. You can relax in comfortable surroundings and pause the film whenever you want. Another benefit is that you don't have to spend money on cinema tickets. However, the experience may not be as exciting because you don't have the same big screen and powerful sound system.

Going to the cinema, on the other hand, can be a memorable experience thanks to the huge screen and excellent sound quality. Besides, it's a great opportunity to spend time with friends and enjoy the special atmosphere of the cinema. The disadvantage is that tickets and snacks can be quite expensive, especially if you go regularly.

Personally, I prefer watching films at the cinema because I love the atmosphere and find films much more impressive on a big screen.

Text me when you have some free time. Bye!

title: Reading books
source:
Hello Kate! How are you doing? I've just found two pictures for our school project "Reading books", and I'd like to explain why I've chosen them.

Both photos show young people enjoying reading, but in different ways. In the first picture, a teenage boy is reading an e-book on his tablet while travelling by train, whereas the second photo shows a teenage girl reading a printed book while relaxing on her bed at home with her dog lying beside her.  Unlike the boy, who is reading on an electronic device, the girl is holding a traditional paper book.

Reading e-books has several advantages. You can store hundreds of books on a single device, which is especially convenient when you're travelling. Besides, you can download new books almost instantly without going to a bookshop. However, reading from a screen for a long time can cause eye strain.

As for printed books, many people enjoy turning real pages and find it easier to concentrate without digital distractions. Another advantage is that you don't need to charge anything before reading. The main disadvantage is that paper books can be quite heavy and take up a lot of space, especially if you have a large collection.

Personally, I prefer reading printed books because I enjoy the feeling of holding a real book and find it more relaxing than reading from a screen.

Give me a call when you have some free time. Bye!

pros.title: Pros & Cons · Reading books
pros.html:
Reading e-books

Advantages

  • You can carry hundreds of books on one device.
  • You can change the font size.
  • New books can be downloaded instantly.
  • Built-in dictionaries help you understand unfamiliar words.

Disadvantages

  • The battery may run out.
  • Reading on a screen can be tiring.
  • Electronic devices can be expensive.
  • Notifications may distract you.

Reading printed books

Advantages

  • You don't need electricity.
  • You can easily lend books to friends.
  • Reading helps you take a break from screens.
  • You can make notes in the margins.

Disadvantages

  • Books can be heavy to carry.
  • They take up space at home.
  • Printed editions can be expensive.
  • Books can easily get damaged.

Hello Daniel! How's it going? I've just found two pictures for our school project "Professions", and I think they are a good choice because they show people doing very different jobs.

In the first picture, a programmer is writing computer code while sitting at his desk, whereas the second photo shows a vet examining a dog at an animal clinic. Unlike the programmer, who is working on his own in front of a computer, the vet is working directly with an animal.

Being a programmer has several advantages. For example, programmers can often work remotely and may earn a good salary. Another benefit is that they can develop useful software and solve interesting problems. However, spending long hours in front of a screen can cause eye strain and back problems.

Working as a vet can be very rewarding because you have the opportunity to help sick animals and sometimes even save their lives. Besides, you get to work with different animals every day, which makes the job interesting. The disadvantage is that it can be emotionally stressful, especially when you have to treat seriously ill animals.

Personally, I would prefer to be a vet because I love animals and would find it satisfying to help them recover from illnesses.

Text me when you have some free time. Bye!

title: Giving presentations
source:
Hello Lucy! How are you doing? I've just found two photos for our school project "Giving presentations", and I'd like to share my ideas about them.

Both pictures show people giving presentations on sustainable cities, but in different ways. In the first photo, a young woman is giving an online presentation from home, using her laptop to communicate with several participants, whereas the second picture shows a woman speaking to an audience in a conference room.Unlike the first speaker, who is interacting with people remotely, the second one is addressing her audience face to face. 

Giving presentations online has several advantages. You can speak to people from different places without having to travel anywhere, which saves both time and money. Another benefit is that you can give your presentation from the comfort of your own home. However, technical problems, such as a poor Internet connection, may interrupt your speech.

Giving a presentation in person can be more engaging because you can make eye contact with your audience and see their reactions immediately. It is also easier to encourage people to ask questions and take part in a discussion. The disadvantage is that speaking in front of a large audience can be quite stressful, especially if you are not used to public speaking.

Personally, I would prefer to give presentations online because I feel more confident speaking from home and find it less stressful than standing in front of an audience.

Text me when you have some free time. Bye!

pros.title: Pros & Cons · Giving presentations
pros.html:
Giving presentations online

Advantages

  • You can present from almost anywhere.
  • There is no need to travel.
  • You can easily share digital materials.
  • Presentations can be recorded for later use.

Disadvantages

  • Internet problems may interrupt you.
  • It is harder to keep the audience interested.
  • You cannot always see people's reactions.
  • Background noise may be distracting.

Giving presentations in person

Advantages

  • You can make eye contact with listeners.
  • It is easier to answer questions.
  • You receive immediate feedback.
  • Body language helps you express your ideas.

Disadvantages

  • Speaking in front of people can be stressful.
  • You may forget what you want to say.
  • Preparing the equipment can take time.
  • Unexpected interruptions may affect your confidence.

title: Volunteering
source:
Hello Andrew! How are you? I've found two photos for our school project "Volunteering", and I'd like to explain why I've chosen them.

Both pictures show people doing voluntary work, but in different ways. In the first photo, a group of volunteers are looking after dogs at an animal shelter, feeding them and cleaning the area, whereas the second picture shows several young people collecting litter in a park. The main difference is that the first group are helping animals, while the second group are protecting the environment.

Volunteering at an animal shelter can be very rewarding because you help animals that need care and attention. It also gives you a chance to learn how to look after pets properly. However, this kind of work can be physically demanding, especially when you have to clean cages and carry heavy bags of food.

Cleaning up a park has its benefits as well. You can make your neighbourhood a cleaner and more pleasant place while spending time outdoors with other volunteers. On the other hand, collecting litter can be unpleasant, particularly when you have to deal with dirty or potentially dangerous rubbish.

Personally, I would prefer to volunteer at an animal shelter because I love dogs and would enjoy making their lives better.

Give me a call when you have some free time. Bye!

title: Studying
source:
Hello Emma! How are you doing? I've found two photos for our school project "Ways of studying", and I think they'll work well for our project.

Studying alone has several advantages. You can concentrate better without other people distracting you. What's more, you can work at your own pace and organise your study time as you like. However, if you find something difficult, there is no one to help you.

One disadvantage, though, is that group members may get distracted by chatting instead of focusing on their studies.

Personally, I prefer studying on my own because I find it easier to maintain focus in a quiet environment.

title: Keeping fit

Unlike the first photo, which shows people taking part in a team sport, the second picture depicts a man training on his own.

When it comes to playing basketball, it's an excellent way to improve your physical fitness and develop teamwork skills. Another advantage is that you can make new friends and enjoy some friendly competition. The downside, though, is that you need other players to organise a game, which isn't always convenient.

Personally, I would prefer to play basketball because I enjoy team sports and find exercising with other people much more exciting than training alone.

Text me when you have some free time. Bye!

pros.title: Pros & Cons · Spending time with pets
pros.html:
Playing with a cat

Advantages

  • Playing helps keep your cat active.
  • It can reduce stress after a busy day.
  • You can play together indoors.
  • It helps you build a bond with your pet.

Disadvantages

  • Cats may scratch you accidentally.
  • Some cats lose interest quickly.
  • Toys may get lost or damaged.
  • Cat hair can cause allergic reactions.

Walking a dog

Advantages

  • Walking keeps both you and your dog active.
  • You get fresh air every day.
  • You may meet other dog owners.
  • Regular walks help establish a healthy routine.

Disadvantages

  • Dogs need walks even in bad weather.
  • You have to clean up after your pet.
  • Some dogs can be difficult to control.
  • Walking a dog takes time every day.

You can get some fresh air, enjoy nature and do some exercise, which is good for your health. However, this activity depends on the weather, as going for a walk may not be very enjoyable when it's cold or raining.

The main drawback is that some teenagers may find board games rather boring because they prefer more active forms of entertainment.

Personally, I would prefer to go for a walk with my family because I enjoy being outdoors and it gives us a chance to chat about our day.

Call me when you have some free time. Bye!

Going for a family walk

  • Walking together helps family members communicate.
  • Everyone gets some fresh air.
  • It is a healthy way to relax.
  • You can discover new places together.

Disadvantages

  • Bad weather can spoil your plans.
  • Younger children may get tired.
  • Family members may prefer different routes.
  • Walking may seem boring to some teenagers.

Playing board games

Advantages

  • Board games develop logical thinking.
  • They encourage family members to interact.
  • You can play regardless of the weather.
  • They teach children to follow rules.

  • Players may argue about the rules.
  • Some games take too long.
  • Losing can be frustrating.
  • Board games involve little physical activity.

title: Keeping in touch with friends

Both photos show people keeping in touch with their friends, but in different ways. In the first picture, a teenage girl is having a video call with her friend from home, whereas the second photo shows two teenagers, a boy and a girl, chatting together at an outdoor café. Unlike the people in the first photo, who are communicating online, the friends in the second picture are spending time together in person.

Both ways of keeping in touch have their advantages and disadvantages. Chatting online is really convenient because you can talk to your friends even if they live far away. Besides, you can see each other's faces without having to leave home. However, technical problems, such as a poor Internet connection, can interrupt your conversation.

As for meeting friends at a café, it gives you a chance to enjoy face-to-face communication and spend quality time together. For example, you can share your news, have a laugh and enjoy a meal or a drink. However, it can sometimes be difficult to find time to meet up, especially when you're busy with your studies.

Personally, I prefer meeting my friends in person because I find face-to-face conversations more enjoyable and it's easier to share our feelings when we're together.

Give me a call when you have some free time. Bye!

Advantages

  • You can stay close to friends who live far away.
  • Video calls save travelling time.
  • You can share important news immediately.
  • It is easy to arrange a short conversation.

Disadvantages

  • Poor connections may interrupt conversations.
  • You cannot do many activities together.
  • Long calls can cause screen fatigue.
  • Time differences may make calling difficult.

Advantages

  • Face-to-face conversations feel more personal.
  • You can enjoy food and drinks together.
  • It is easier to understand people's emotions.
  • Meeting outside gives you a change of scenery.

Disadvantages

title: Education
source:
Hello Andrew! How are you doing? I've just found two pictures for our school project "Education", and I'd like to explain why they suit the project.

Both photos show students learning, but in completely different environments. In the first photo, young people are receiving vocational training by repairing a car engine with their teacher, whereas the second picture shows university students listening to a lecture in a large lecture hall. Unlike the first group, who are learning through practical experience, the students in the second photo are mainly listening to their professor.

Both types of education have their advantages and disadvantages. As for vocational training, it provides valuable hands-on experience, which is highly appreciated by employers and can improve students' chances of finding a job. The main drawback is that practical work can be physically demanding, and there is also a risk of injuries.

University lectures, by contrast, allow students to gain in-depth theoretical knowledge and develop critical thinking skills. Besides, they have an opportunity to learn from experienced academics. However, lectures often lack practical activities, so graduates may need to do internships to gain the necessary skills.

Personally, I would prefer vocational training because I learn best by doing things with my own hands.

That's all for now. I'm looking forward to your call. Goodbye!

title: Celebrating birthdays
source:

Both photos show people celebrating birthdays, but in different ways. In the first picture, a boy is having a birthday meal at home with his parents, while the second photo shows a girl celebrating her birthday with friends at a café. In contrast to the first photo, where the boy is enjoying pizza with his family, the girl in the second picture is about to blow out the candles on her birthday cake.

Both ways of celebrating have their advantages and disadvantages. Having a birthday party with your nearest and dearest strengthens family bonds and creates wonderful memories that will last for years. One possible downside is that some teenagers might find a quiet family celebration a little boring because there isn't much to do.

Having a birthday party at a café, on the other hand, can be really enjoyable because you can chat, laugh and have fun with your friends. Besides, you don't have to worry about preparing food or cleaning up afterwards. The disadvantage is that eating out can be quite expensive, especially if you invite a lot of people.

Personally, I prefer celebrating my birthday with my family because it's a special occasion when we can all get together and enjoy each other's company.

That's all for now. Call me when you have some free time. Bye!

Painting has several advantages. It allows you to express your creativity and relax after a busy day at school. Another benefit is that you can paint whenever you have some free time without depending on anyone else. One possible downside is that painting requires a lot of patience, and art materials can be quite expensive. What's more, it can be a messy activity, so you may have to spend some time cleaning up afterwards.

Playing music in a band can also be very enjoyable because you can share your passion for music with other people. Besides, it can boost your creativity because you can compose your own music and write lyrics. However, learning to play a musical instrument takes a lot of time and practice, which can be difficult to combine with schoolwork.

Personally, I would prefer to paint because I enjoy peaceful activities and find painting a great way to relax and express my feelings.

Another benefit is that you can avoid sitting in a waiting room with other patients. On the other hand, the doctor cannot examine you properly through a screen, which may make it difficult to diagnose certain illnesses.

As for visiting a clinic, it allows doctors to carry out a physical examination and perform medical tests on site. This can help them make a more accurate diagnosis. One possible disadvantage is that you may have to spend a long time waiting for your appointment, especially if the clinic is busy.

Personally, I would prefer to see a doctor in person because I think a physical examination is important for getting an accurate diagnosis.

title: Gaining knowledge

Both pictures show schoolchildren learning new things, but in different ways. In the first photo, a teenage girl is answering a question during a geography lesson, while her classmates are listening to her. The second picture shows a group of students carrying out a science experiment. They are mixing different substances in laboratory equipment and recording their observations. Unlike the students in the first photo, who are learning in a traditional classroom setting, the children in the second picture are gaining knowledge through practical experience.

Both approaches to learning have their advantages and disadvantages. Traditional classroom lessons allow students to learn important facts and understand new concepts with the help of a teacher. title: Learning foreign languages
source:
Hello Kate! How are things going? I've found two photos for our school project "Learning foreign languages", and I'd like to share my thoughts on why they are suitable.

Both pictures show teenagers learning English, but in different ways. In the first photo, a teenage girl is studying English on her own using an app on her tablet. She is wearing headphones and doing an interactive exercise. The other picture shows a group of teenagers studying English together at a language school, with a teacher helping them. The main difference is that the girl in the first photo is learning independently, whereas the students in the second picture are studying in a group.

Learning a foreign language with an app has several advantages. You can study whenever and wherever you want and learn at your own pace. Another benefit is that language-learning apps allow you to repeat difficult exercises as many times as you need until you understand the material. However, it can be difficult to stay motivated without a teacher, and you may not get enough speaking practice.

Attending language classes, on the other hand, gives you the opportunity to practise speaking with other students and receive immediate feedback from a teacher. Besides, regular lessons help you stay motivated and make steady progress because you have a clear study plan. The disadvantage is that you have to follow a fixed timetable, which may be inconvenient if you have a lot of schoolwork.

Personally, I prefer learning English in a group because I enjoy communicating with other students and find it easier to understand difficult topics when a teacher explains them.

I hope we can discuss the project soon. Talk to you later! Bye!

title: Buying food
source:
Hello Andrew! How's it going? I've chosen two photos for our school project "Buying food", and I'd like to tell you how they illustrate the topic.

Both pictures show people buying food, but in different places. In the first photo, a man in his fifties is buying fresh tomatoes at an outdoor market. He is standing in front of a stall with a wide selection of fresh vegetables and talking to the stallholder. The other picture shows a woman in her thirties choosing food and putting it into a shopping trolley in a large supermarket. Unlike the man in the first photo, who is buying vegetables directly from a stallholder, the woman is choosing products from supermarket shelves.

Both places have their advantages and disadvantages. Shopping at a local market allows you to buy fresh, seasonal produce, often directly from local farmers. Another advantage is that you can talk to the sellers and ask them questions about their products. However, markets usually offer a more limited range of goods, so you may have to visit other shops to buy everything you need.

As for supermarkets, they offer a wide variety of products in one place, which makes shopping more convenient. Besides, you can compare prices and choose between different brands. One possible drawback is that large supermarkets can get very crowded, especially at weekends, which may make shopping stressful and time-consuming.

Personally, I prefer buying food at a supermarket because I can find almost everything I need in one place and don't have to spend time visiting several shops.

title: Dressing for school
source:
Hello Mary! How are you doing? I've picked out two photos for our school project "Dressing for school", and I'd like to explain why they would work well together.

Both photos show students during the school day, but they are dressed very differently. In the first picture, three teenagers are walking outside their school in casual clothes, such as jeans and sweatshirts. The other photo shows four students in a school corridor wearing uniforms with blazers and ties. Unlike the teenagers in the first photo, who can choose what to wear, the students in the second picture have to follow a school dress code.

Both ways of dressing for school have their advantages and disadvantages. Wearing casual clothes allows students to express their individuality and choose outfits that they find comfortable. What's more, they can wear the same clothes outside school, so their parents don't have to spend extra money on a separate uniform. However, some teenagers may feel pressure to wear fashionable or expensive clothes to fit in with their classmates.

School uniforms, on the other hand, help create a sense of belonging and make students feel part of the same school community. Another benefit is that students don't have to waste time deciding what to wear every morning. The main disadvantage is that uniforms can be uncomfortable, especially in hot weather, and students have fewer opportunities to express their personal style.

Personally, I prefer wearing casual clothes to school because I value comfort and like being able to choose what suits me best.

That's what I wanted to share with you. We can talk more about the project later. Bye!

title: Watching sporting events
source:
Hello Daniel! How are things going? I've chosen two photos for our school project "Watching sporting events", and I'd like to explain how they could be used to illustrate the topic.

Both ways of watching sporting events have their advantages and disadvantages. title: Travelling
source:
Hello Mary! How's it going? I've chosen two photos for our school project "Travelling", and I'd like to explain why they could be useful.

Both pictures illustrate different ways of travelling, but they focus on different means of transport. In the foreground of the first photo, there is a large plane heading towards the runway. In the background, we can see the airport buildings and several other planes. The second picture shows a long train travelling along a railway line on a cliff overlooking the sea. Unlike the plane in the first photo, which is at the airport, the train is travelling through a beautiful coastal landscape.

Both means of transport have their advantages and disadvantages. Travelling by plane is the fastest way to cover long distances. It allows passengers to reach another city or even a different country in just a few hours. Besides, flying is particularly convenient when travelling abroad. However, some people are afraid of flying because they feel uncomfortable being so high above the ground.

As for travelling by train, one of its main advantages is that passengers can admire the changing scenery through the windows. They can enjoy beautiful views of forests, mountains and rivers during their journey. Another benefit is that train passengers can usually move around more freely than people on a plane. The main drawback is that train journeys can be very time-consuming, especially over long distances, and sometimes take several days.

Personally, I prefer travelling by plane because it saves a lot of time and allows me to visit distant places without spending days on the journey.

I hope these pictures will help us with our project. Let's talk about them soon. Bye!

Hi Emma! How are you doing? I've found two illustrations for our school project "Exploring the world", and I'd like to explain why I think they would be a good choice.

Both photos illustrate different ways of learning about new places. In the first picture, a young man is wearing a VR headset and taking a virtual tour around Paris. The second photo shows a group of tourists on a guided tour of the French capital. Unlike the young man in the first picture, who is visiting the city virtually, the tourists in the second photo are experiencing it in real life.

Both types of tours have their advantages and disadvantages. Virtual tours allow you to see famous landmarks without leaving home, which saves time and money. Besides, you can learn about places that are too far away or too expensive to visit in person. However, a virtual tour can't fully recreate the atmosphere of a real destination, and you miss the opportunity to experience local culture first-hand.

As for guided tours, they give you a chance to see famous sights with your own eyes and learn interesting facts about them from an experienced guide. Another advantage is that you can ask questions and get immediate answers. The main drawback is that guided tours can be expensive, especially when you have to pay for transport and accommodation as well. What's more, you usually have to follow a fixed schedule.

Personally, I would prefer to explore new places in real life because I enjoy travelling and find it much more memorable than seeing famous sights on a screen.

title: Places to live
source:
Hi Anna! How are you? I've chosen two photos for our school project "Places to live", and I'd like to explain why I think they would work well together.

Both photos show roads with buildings along them, but the surroundings are completely different. Unlike the first picture, which depicts a busy street in a large city, the second photo shows a quiet road in the countryside. While the city street is full of vehicles and pedestrians, there are no cars in the village, and only one man is walking his dog along the road. In contrast to the city, which has many tall buildings, the village consists of small, single-storey houses surrounded by fences.

Both places have their advantages and disadvantages. Living in a big city offers plenty of opportunities for education, employment and entertainment. Besides, cities usually have well-developed public transport systems, so it's easier to get around without a car. However, city life can be stressful because of heavy traffic, noise and air pollution.

As for living in the countryside, you can enjoy fresh air, beautiful scenery and a slower pace of life. Another benefit is that people often know their neighbours well and have a stronger sense of community. However, there may be fewer job opportunities and limited access to shops, hospitals and other essential services.

Personally, I would prefer to live in a big city because I enjoy having plenty of things to do and I like being able to get almost anywhere by public transport.

I hope these photos will be useful for our project. Let me know what you think. Goodbye!

Personally, I would prefer to travel by taxi because I value comfort and like being able to reach my destination without worrying about bus timetables.

title: Places to go for a walk
source:
Hello Mary! How's it going? I've selected two photos for our school project "Places to go for a walk", and I'd like to explain why I think they would be a good choice.

Both photos show places where people can enjoy a walk near the water, but the surroundings are quite different. The first picture depicts a city park with an artificial pond and a fountain. Some people are walking along the paths, while others are relaxing on benches. In contrast to this well-maintained urban park, the second photo shows a peaceful forest with a path running alongside a lake. A man and a woman are walking together, enjoying the natural surroundings.

There are several reasons why people enjoy walking in city parks. They are usually easy to reach, and you don't have to travel far to spend some time outdoors. Parks also have comfortable paths and benches where you can sit down and relax. The problem is that they can become very crowded, especially at weekends, so it may be difficult to find a quiet spot.

A walk in the forest offers a different experience. Being surrounded by trees and listening to the sounds of nature can help you forget about everyday worries and reduce stress. You may even have a chance to see wild animals or birds in their natural habitat. On the other hand, forest paths are not always suitable for walking, particularly after heavy rain, and it can be easy to lose your way if you don't know the area well.

Personally, I prefer walking in the forest because I enjoy the peaceful atmosphere and find it easier to relax away from the noise and crowds of the city.

I hope these pictures will help us with our project. I'd love to know what you think. Goodbye!

title: Protecting the environment
source:
Hello Andrew! How are things going? I've come across two photos for our school project "Protecting the environment", and I'd like to share my thoughts on why they would be suitable.

Both pictures show people taking part in activities aimed at protecting the environment. In the first photo, several young people are collecting rubbish on a beach. They are wearing light clothes, so it is probably a warm summer day. The second picture shows a man and two women planting a young tree in a park. Judging by the surroundings, it could be early autumn. Unlike the volunteers in the first photo, who are removing waste from a natural area, the people in the second picture are helping to make their local environment greener.

Both activities play an important role in protecting nature, although each has its own benefits and challenges. Cleaning up beaches helps prevent plastic and other waste from entering the sea and harming marine animals. It makes the coastline cleaner and safer for visitors as well. The difficulty is that collecting rubbish can be unpleasant and physically tiring, especially in hot weather.

Planting trees, in turn, can improve air quality because trees absorb carbon dioxide from the atmosphere. What's more, they provide habitats for birds and other wildlife. One challenge, though, is that newly planted trees need regular watering and care, particularly during dry periods. Without proper attention, they may not survive.

Personally, I would prefer to take part in a tree-planting activity because I like the idea of making a lasting contribution to the environment. It would be rewarding to watch a tree grow over the years, knowing that I had helped plant it.

I hope these photos will be useful for our project. We can discuss them when we meet. Goodbye!

The downside is that not everything published online is reliable, so you need to be careful about which websites you trust.

Reading printed newspapers offers a different experience. They often contain detailed articles that help readers understand events in greater depth. What's more, reading a newspaper can be more relaxing because you are less likely to be distracted by notifications or messages. Personally, I prefer reading the news on my smartphone because it is convenient and allows me to stay informed even when I'm travelling or waiting for public transport.

title: Attending concerts
source:
Hello Kate! How are you? I've found two photos for our school project "Attending concerts", and I'd like to share my ideas about why they would be suitable.

Both pictures show people attending live music performances, but the concerts are quite different. In the first photo, the musicians of an orchestra are performing classical music in a concert hall. They are playing various instruments, including violins, cellos and drums, while a conductor is directing the performance. People in the audience are sitting and listening attentively. In contrast, the second picture shows an outdoor rock concert, where people in casual clothes are dancing on the sand and enjoying the music. There are stalls in the background where visitors can probably buy food or drinks.

Each type of concert has its own advantages and disadvantages. Classical music concerts give you an opportunity to appreciate the skill of professional musicians and enjoy beautiful music in a peaceful atmosphere. The excellent acoustics of concert halls make the performance even more enjoyable. However, tickets can be quite expensive, and some people may find sitting quietly throughout a long concert rather tiring.

Outdoor rock concerts, on the other hand, are usually full of energy and excitement. You can dance, sing along to your favourite songs and have fun with other music fans. What's more, the informal atmosphere makes it easy to relax and socialise with other music fans. The disadvantage is that outdoor concerts depend on the weather, so rain or strong winds can spoil the event.

Personally, I would prefer to attend an outdoor rock concert because I enjoy lively music and love the idea of dancing and singing along with a large crowd.

I hope these photos will help us with our project. Let me know what you think. Bye!

title: Learning history

Unlike the family in the first photo, who are exploring a historic site, the students are learning about the past with the help of a professional guide.

Visiting historic sites has several advantages. It allows you to see places where people lived and important events took place centuries ago. Besides, walking around an ancient castle can make history feel much more real than simply reading about it in a textbook. However, some historic sites are far from major cities, so getting there can be expensive and time-consuming.

As for guided museum tours, they give you an opportunity to learn interesting facts from an experienced guide and ask questions about the exhibits. What's more, you can examine historical objects up close and gain a better understanding of how people lived in the past. One possible disadvantage is that you usually have to follow the group's schedule, which means you may not have enough time to explore everything that interests you.

Personally, I would prefer to visit historic sites because I love exploring old buildings and imagining what life was like there hundreds of years ago.

Hello Emma! How are you? I've found two photos for our school project "Learning About Space", and I'd like to explain why I think they are suitable.

Both pictures show people learning about space, but in different ways. In the first photo, a father and his son are looking at the stars through a telescope outdoors. The sky is full of stars, and they seem to be somewhere in the countryside, away from the bright lights of the city. The second picture shows a group of visitors, possibly schoolchildren, attending a presentation at a planetarium. Unlike the father and son in the first photo, who are observing the real night sky, the visitors in the second picture are learning about space indoors.

Both activities have their advantages and disadvantages. Besides, spending time outdoors under a starry sky can be a memorable experience, especially if you share it with someone close to you. However, stargazing depends on the weather, and clouds or light pollution can make it difficult to see anything clearly.

As for visiting a planetarium, it allows you to explore distant planets, stars and galaxies through impressive visual presentations. What's more, you can learn fascinating facts from a knowledgeable guide and ask questions about things you don't understand. The downside is that you are watching images rather than observing real objects in space, so the experience may feel less authentic.

Personally, I would prefer to look at the stars through a telescope because I find the idea of observing the night sky fascinating. I think seeing the Moon or distant planets with my own eyes would be unforgettable.

pros.title: Pros & Cons · Learning about space
pros.html:
Observing the sky through a telescope

Advantages

  • You can observe real celestial objects.
  • Stargazing encourages scientific curiosity.
  • You can learn to recognise constellations.
  • Observing the night sky can be fascinating.

Disadvantages

  • Cloudy weather makes observation difficult.
  • Good telescopes can be expensive.
  • City lights may hide the stars.
  • Finding distant objects requires practice.

Visiting a planetarium

Advantages

  • You can explore space through realistic projections.
  • Shows explain complex astronomical ideas.
  • You can learn regardless of the weather.
  • Planetariums offer an engaging educational experience.

Disadvantages

  • You are not observing real celestial objects.
  • Tickets may be expensive.
  • Shows follow a fixed timetable.
  • Popular sessions may be crowded.

title: Doing housework
source:
Hello Anna! How's everything going? I've come across two photos for our school project "Doing Housework", and I'd like to explain why I think they would be suitable.

Both pictures show different ways of doing housework, but the situations are quite different. In the first photo, a young woman is sitting on a sofa in her living room and reading a book while a robot vacuum cleaner is washing the floor. In contrast, the second picture shows a man using a traditional vacuum cleaner in his living room. Unlike the woman in the first photo, who can relax while the robot is doing the work, the man has to move around the room and do the housework himself.

Both methods have their advantages and disadvantages. Using a robot vacuum cleaner saves time and effort because it can take care of the floors automatically while you are busy with other activities. Besides, many modern models can be programmed to work at certain times, even when nobody is at home. However, these devices can be expensive, and they may have difficulty reaching corners or getting into narrow spaces.

As for traditional vacuum cleaners, they allow you to remove dust and dirt more thoroughly, especially from carpets and hard-to-reach areas. Another benefit is that you can decide which parts of the room need extra attention. The disadvantage is that vacuuming manually takes time and can be tiring, particularly if you have a large house or several rooms to tidy up.

Personally, I prefer using a robot vacuum cleaner because it makes housework much easier and gives me more free time for my hobbies. I like the idea of keeping my home tidy without having to spend hours doing household chores.

I hope these pictures will be useful for our project. I'll share some more ideas with you when we meet. Bye!

pros.title: Pros & Cons · Doing housework
pros.html:
Using a robot vacuum cleaner

Advantages

  • It cleans floors automatically.
  • You can save time on housework.
  • Cleaning can be scheduled in advance.
  • It can work while you are away.

Disadvantages

  • Robot vacuum cleaners can be expensive.
  • They cannot clean stairs.
  • Small objects may block their movement.
  • They need regular charging and maintenance.

Using a traditional vacuum cleaner

Advantages

  • You can clean specific areas thoroughly.
  • It is suitable for different surfaces.
  • You can reach corners and furniture.
  • Many models have powerful suction.

Disadvantages

  • Vacuuming requires physical effort.
  • Cleaning the whole house takes time.
  • Traditional vacuum cleaners can be noisy.
  • Large models take up storage space.
